def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==3]
    o=[row[:] for row in g]
    # flood outside zeros from border
    outd=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; q=deque()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r in(0,H-1) or c in(0,W-1)) and g[r][c]==0: outd[r][c]=True; q.append((r,c))
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not outd[nr][nc] and g[nr][nc]==0:
                outd[nr][nc]=True; q.append((nr,nc))
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==0 and not outd[r][c]:
                d=min(max(abs(r-sr),abs(c-sc)) for sr,sc in seeds)
                o[r][c]=4 if d%2==1 else 2
    return o
